name: Cryonic-Gnomon
description: Cold has crystallized everything here into geometry: dune-fields of frost, canyons of clear blue ice, and far off, past towering mountain ranges, a light that lingers blue long after sunset.

There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure. Mats of pigment-bearing microbes stain the wet stone in bands of rust and violet.
Around the signal of unknown origin, reality bends in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
There is money in nitrogen here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
